notes.title: Language Update — Spanish and Portuguese Added!
notes.content: We’re happy to announce that Spanish and Portuguese languages have been added to Lost Infinity.

notes.title: Update: Lost Infinity is now available in Japanese and Korean!
notes.content:
What’s new in this update:

Full text localization into Japanese and Korean

notes.title: Update: The game is now available in Chinese!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Lost Infinity now supports Simplified Chinese!
This is an important step for us, and we hope players from China will enjoy immersing themselves in the atmosphere of our story.


What's new in this update:

Full text localization into Simplified Chinese

Minor bug fixes

Sincerely,
Void Echo
